knowledge_graph.title: Influenza A virus subtype H3N2
knowledge_graph.description: Influenza A virus subtype H3N2 is a subtype of influenza A virus. Some human-adapted strains of A/H3N2 are endemic in humans and are one cause of seasonal influenza. Other strains of H1N1 are endemic in pigs and in birds.
